name: 8085 assignment 5
desc: This is a simple 8085 assembly language program that stores the value 42H in memory location 9000H, finds the 2's complement of the number, and stores it back in memory location 9008H.

files.sketch.ino:
; Store the number 42H in 9000H.Find 2’S compliment 
; of the number and store it back in 9008H.

LXI H,9008H
MVI M,42H ; // MOVE 42H INTO THE MEMORY LOCATION SPECIFIED BY HL REGISTER PAIR.
LDA 9008H
CMA
ADI 01H
STA 9008H
HLT

; END OF CODE
